scope: N0 local research protocol, identity uses and same-age controls only

grouping.ordering: sha256(UTF-8(seed + ':' + subject_id)), ascending; first calibration_identity_count calibration, remainder research holdout
grouping.unit: identity, including all ages, originals and derived artifacts
grouping.near_duplicate_screening: pending; required before any formal independent evaluation

source_age_evidence.fgnet: mirror filename label; not independently verified; research field only, not SourceAge.method=user or estimated
source_age_evidence.fractional_source_age: preserve exact value; no same-age generation until N5 defines fractional conditioning; never round

geometry_policy.normalization_reference: one unchanged source canonical center and uniform scale per source, shared by every target and control
geometry_policy.expression: primary geometry comparison uses neutral expression for source, same-age and targets; expression coefficients and posed fits reported separately
geometry_policy.pose: record separately; no independent per-target centering, rescaling or Procrustes fitting of primary differences
geometry_policy.model_binding: same model hashes, topology hash, vertex order and direction basis
geometry_policy.truth: 3DDFA fits are geometry proxies, not measured cross-age 3D ground truth

statistics.aggregation: average within identity first, then equal-weight identity macro average; report median and per-identity distribution
statistics.cross_age_pairs: all adult source-target pairs with distinct labeled ages within each identity; both directions; aggregate within identity
statistics.uncertainty: 95 percent identity-cluster bootstrap, 2000 resamples, seed 20261020; omit intervals with fewer than 2 eligible identities
statistics.failures: retain every requested case and stage-specific failure; report numerator and all-requested denominator as well as conditional quality on successes
statistics.coverage: report identities, images and distinct ages by group; no age-70 truth present, no 20-70 accuracy claim

metrics.same_age_drift: SAM(s) versus unaltered source; image appearance, fitted neutral geometry, pose and expression separately
metrics.age: target conditioning is not ground truth; age MAE or trend requires a separately licensed, version-pinned evaluator with domain validation
metrics.identity: same-person and different-person comparisons matched by age/quality, identity macro summaries; independent licensed evaluator required for accuracy claims
metrics.geometry: finite vertices, fixed topology, neutral-geometry RMS and maximum vertex displacement in source canonical units; BFM and SAM-difference baselines reported separately
metrics.uv: later N4: observed coverage, unknown and occluded regions, seams and GLB roundtrip; generated pixels are not source observations
metrics.continuity: later N5: source reset, adjacent-age displacement and roundtrip drift; interpolation and generator conditioning assessed separately
metrics.performance: cold load, warm inference, alignment, refitting, UV and end-to-end measured separately

thresholds.stage1_integrity: all declared hashes and sizes match; no identity or exact-byte duplicate across uses; viewed identities development-only; unknown remains null; all 8 eligible same-age controls present
thresholds.quality_threshold_status: not established; no G3 quality pass permitted
thresholds.freeze_rule: choose quality thresholds and evaluator versions on development/calibration only in a versioned amendment before opening research holdout results; never tune on holdout
thresholds.holdout_reuse: if used for tuning or threshold selection, retire that holdout claim and publish a new protocol with fresh eligible data

permission_boundary: existing local research scope only; license statuses unchanged; no image redistribution or training
